title: Crash on quit when running script with -s flag while autoload singleton is registered via add_autoload_singleton
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1], v4.6.beta.custom_build [bb92a4c8e]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.5.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M2 Max (Apple8) - Apple M2 Max (12 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

When running a script that extends SceneTree using the -s command line flag, and an autoload singleton is registered via add_autoload_singleton() in an enabled editor plugin, the engine crashes on quit.
